newsitem.title: UK: Tunisia buys total 27,000 tonnes soybean oil-trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia buys total 27,000 tonnes soybean oil-trade.

text.p: Tunisia bought a total of 27,000 tonnes of soybean oil at a tender on Thursday, European vegetable oil traders.
The purchase was split into three shipment periods. In the first lot, due to arrive between May 5-15, 6,000 tonnes of soy oil was purchased at $548, 3,000 tonnes at $546.50 and 3,000 tonnes at $547.
The second shipment was due to arrive June 1-10 with 6,000 tonnes bought at $548, 3,000 at $549 and 3,000 at $548.
Arrival for the third shipment of 3,000 tonnes was July 20-30 and the purchase price for this parcel was $549 a tonne c and f.
Traders also said Morocco passed on a tender.
